import json,subprocess,sys,time,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
from benchmark_tools import run_fault_reported_native_review as module

from benchmark_tools.probe_dgx_step_separation import save
from benchmark_tools.run_native_factorial_cost import read
root=module.ROOT;request=record(module.REQUEST);assert request["sha256"]==module.REQUEST_SHA
req=read(request);plan=read(req["plan"])
for ref in [request,req["plan"],*plan["helper_sources"],*plan["evidence"]]:check(ref)
assert len(plan["helper_sources"])==920
assert record(module.REVIEWER)["sha256"]==module.REVIEWER_SHA and record(module.VALIDATOR)["sha256"]==module.VALIDATOR_SHA
assert not module.CONTROL.exists() and not module.DESTINATION.exists()
batch=record(module.BATCH);subprocess.run(["bash","-n",str(module.BATCH)],check=True)
command=[str(module.PYTHON),"-B","-c","import sys,Bio,numpy,psutil; import benchmark_tools.run_fault_reported_native_review as m; print(sys.version.split()[0],Bio.__version__,numpy.__version__,psutil.__version__,m.MEMORY)"]
runtime=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
assert runtime.stdout.split()==["3.10.13","1.87","2.2.6","7.2.2",str(module.MEMORY)]
helpcmd=[str(module.PYTHON),"-B","-m","benchmark_tools.run_fault_reported_native_review","--help"]
helpresult=subprocess.run(helpcmd,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
accountcmd=["sacct","-j","22734","--format=JobID,State,ExitCode,Elapsed","-P"]
account=subprocess.run(accountcmd,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
assert "22734|RUNNING|0:0|" in account.stdout
pscmd=["ps","-p","1198962","-o","pid,ppid,stat,etime,time,rss"]
process=subprocess.run(pscmd,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
assert "1198962" in process.stdout
receipts=[]
for name,expected in [("fault_reported_native_review_tests_20261006_v1.xml",(196,1)),("fault_reported_native_review_tests_20261006_v2.xml",(197,0))]:
    path=root/"benchmark_tools/results"/name
    suite=ET.parse(path).getroot().find("testsuite")
    assert (int(suite.attrib["tests"]),int(suite.attrib["failures"]))==expected
    assert suite.attrib["errors"]==suite.attrib["skipped"]=="0"
    receipts.append(dict(reference=record(path),counts=suite.attrib))
out=root/"benchmark_tools/results/fault_reported_native_review_preparation_20261006.json";assert not out.exists()
save(out,dict(schema="fault_reported_native_review_preparation_v1",observer_command=sys.orig_argv,observed_unix_ns=time.time_ns(),request=request,plan=req["plan"],worker=record(module.__file__),tests=record(root/"tests/unit/test_run_fault_reported_native_review.py"),batch=batch,protocol=record(root/"benchmark_tools/results/FAULT_REPORTED_NATIVE_REVIEW_PROTOCOL_20261006.md"),test_receipts=receipts,helper_sources_checked=920,scientific_runtime=dict(command=command,stdout=runtime.stdout,stderr=runtime.stderr,python=record(module.PYTHON)),cli_help=dict(command=helpcmd,stdout=helpresult.stdout,stderr=helpresult.stderr),original_diagnostic=dict(command=accountcmd,stdout=account.stdout,stderr=account.stderr,output_read=False),owned_process=dict(command=pscmd,stdout=process.stdout,stderr=process.stderr),review_limit_bytes=module.MEMORY,review_cpu_slots=2,review_hours=6,diagnostic_digest=None,submission_executed=False,full_review_executed=False,native_inference_reexecuted=False,scientific_timings_admitted=False,next_identity_authorized=False,publication_ready=False))
print(json.dumps(dict(preparation=record(out),diagnostic=account.stdout)))
